# MAP HEAT RESEARCH

You research the **top-2 SPX/RUT captains** supplied by the mechanical map.
Post-close batches cover every industry with a liquid captain; the morning
batch refreshes only hot/cold/OVERRIDE/calendar names. You do **not** write
stock essays.
You do **not** re-describe the heatmap.

## Job 1 — captain cards (JSON first)

Input is a compact board: industry, parent residual, SPX captains, RUT captains,
tape, calendar. For each industry:

1. Look up current ticker-tagged news and X on **only those tickers**.
2. Decide sub-sector direction from the captains + residual, not from the parent ETF.
3. Sentiment is pos / neg / mixed / none from **today's** evidence, not the keyword stub.

Return ONE fenced json block first:

```json
{
  "date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "cards": [
    {
      "industry": "Uranium",
      "sector": "Energy",
      "action": "OVERRIDE",
      "subsector_dir": "up",
      "conviction": "medium",
      "captains": [
        {
          "ticker": "UEC",
          "index": "RUT",
          "sent": "pos",
          "why": "one line",
          "evidence": [
            {
              "source": "Reuters",
              "url": "https://...",
              "published_at": "2026-08-26T06:15:00-04:00",
              "fact": "specific fact that changed sentiment"
            }
          ],
          "x_sentiment": {
            "used": true,
            "label": "pos",
            "mention_delta_24h": 1.4,
            "sample_urls": ["https://x.com/..."],
            "reason": ""
          },
          "search_note": "queries attempted; required when sent=none"
        }
      ],
      "one_line": "Energy ETF is oil-weak; uranium captains confirm the nested long.",
      "do_not": "bury in XLE DOWN"
    }
  ]
}
```

Rules:
- `subsector_dir` is up / down / flat.
- `conviction` is high / medium / low. High only if both captains agree AND news agrees with the tape residual.
- Skip an industry if it has zero liquid captains — do not invent tickers.
- Return one card for every supplied industry. Never invent a ticker that was
  not in the supplied SPX/RUT captain list.
- A non-`none` sentiment without a current URL, timestamp and specific fact is
  INVALID. Price movement alone is not sentiment.
- `none` is honest and acceptable, but include `search_note`.
- X is required only in the morning hot-list refresh. If unavailable, set
  `x_sentiment.used=false`; never fake mention counts.
- one_line ≤ 160 chars. why ≤ 120 chars.

## Job 2 — opportunity synthesis (JSON first)

You see the full map-heat board PLUS the captain cards. Answer only:

**Where is money moving that the 11 sector ETFs will miss or mislabel?**

```json
{
  "date": "YYYY-MM-DD",
  "size_gate": true,
  "size_gate_reason": "PCE 08:30 + NVDA AMC",
  "parent_splits": [
    {
      "sector": "Energy",
      "long": ["Uranium"],
      "avoid": ["Oil & Gas Integrated"],
      "why": "oil tape red, uranium captains bid"
    }
  ],
  "opportunities": [
    {
      "id": "uranium_nested",
      "side": "long",
      "tickers": ["UEC", "UUUU"],
      "why": "OVERRIDE vs Energy; RUT captains pos",
      "horizon": "1w"
    }
  ],
  "vetoes": [
    {"what": "XLK notable UP", "why": "NVDA print tonight; size_gate"}
  ],
  "one_paragraph": "four to six sentences. no essay."
}
```

Hard rules:
- If size_gate is on, do not promote a broad SPX/XLK "UP notable".
- Nested OVERRIDE is the product. Never average uranium into Energy.
- Tickers in opportunities MUST appear as captains (or be the obvious liquid leader already on the card). No $20m names.
- one_paragraph is the only prose. JSON first.

CAPTAIN_CARDS_OK
OPPORTUNITY_OK


[RESEARCH MODE] You have native web search and X search — use them yourself to research live sources before answering; there is no external search tool in this conversation. Produce the required output exactly as specified above, then append a final section titled RESEARCH APPENDIX listing the queries you ran, the key sources (title + URL + timestamp where available), and the specific facts you took from each. Never invent sources.

```json
{
  "date": "2026-09-01",
  "size_gate": false,
  "size_gate_reason": "post-close baseline only; overnight futures/calendar refresh pre-open; COMPLETED_CALENDAR_ACTUAL_VS_CONSENSUS empty",
  "parent_splits": [
    {
      "sector": "Basic Materials",
      "long": ["Coking Coal", "Steel"],
      "avoid": ["Gold"],
      "why": "XLB -1% c2c hides met-coal/steel OVERRIDE; gold HEAT is residual, not an NEM/SSRM ops break"
    },
    {
      "sector": "Consumer Cyclical",
      "long": ["Auto Manufacturers", "Specialty Retail"],
      "avoid": ["Apparel Manufacturing", "Luxury Goods", "Travel Services", "Textile Manufacturing", "Resorts & Casinos"],
      "why": "XLY +0.6% is TSLA/Cybercab; WSM nested vs CASY wait; apparel/textiles/travel/casinos residual-down"
    },
    {

      "long": ["Oil & Gas Equipment & Services"],

    },
    {

      "long": [],

      "why": "XLP flat hides BF-B spirits HEAT into FQ1 09/02"
    }
  ],
  "opportunities": [
    {
      "id": "coking_hcc",
      "side": "long",
      "tickers": ["HCC"],
      "why": "OVERRIDE vs XLB; Blue Creek FY tons raised; AMR is the miss",
      "horizon": "1w"
    },
    {
      "id": "steel_mills",
      "side": "long",
      "tickers": ["NUE", "STLD"],
      "why": "OVERRIDE vs XLB; tariff-price beat, record mill shipments",
      "horizon": "1w"
    },
    {
      "id": "tsla_cybercab",
      "side": "long",
      "tickers": ["TSLA"],
      "why": "OVERRIDE vs XLY; Cybercab Sep 3 Austin, not GM/LCID",
      "horizon": "1w"
    },
    {
      "id": "wsm_nested",
      "side": "long",
      "tickers": ["WSM"],
      "why": "SPLIT vs specialty DOWN; Q2 comps +6.2% and FY raise vs CASY/ASO",
      "horizon": "1w"
    },
    {
      "id": "slb_kelvion",
      "side": "long",
      "tickers": ["SLB"],
      "why": "OFS SPLIT vs XLE oil; $3.4B Kelvion AI-cooling bid",
      "horizon": "1w"
    },
    {
      "id": "rrr_locals",
      "side": "long",
      "tickers": ["RRR"],
      "why": "nested vs LVS/MGM; GVR East Tower rooms back in September",
      "horizon": "1w"
    },
    {
      "id": "bfb_fq1",
      "side": "short",
      "tickers": ["BF-B"],
      "why": "HEAT vs XLP; FQ1 09/02 after prior miss, staples discount",
      "horizon": "1w"
    },
    {
      "id": "ain_cfo",
      "side": "short",
      "tickers": ["AIN"],
      "why": "SPLIT vs XLY; CFO medical leave Aug 31; do not bounce textiles",
      "horizon": "1w"
    }
  ],
  "vetoes": [
    {"what": "XLB DOWN as materials-cycle short", "why": "gold HEAT is not ops; steel/coking OVERRIDE sit underneath"},
    {"what": "XLY UP as discretionary beta", "why": "TSLA Cybercab; apparel/textiles/travel residual-down"},
    {"what": "XLE UP as oil-services/oil confirmation", "why": "SLB is Kelvion cooling; E&P lags; coal captains do not confirm"},
    {"what": "XLK/SPX notable UP", "why": "post-close baseline; no morning size_gate; XLK -1.1% c2c"},
    {"what": "Thermal coal HEAT upgrade", "why": "CNR quiet; BTU Centurion loss/lawsuit-neg"},
    {"what": "AMR into coking OVERRIDE", "why": "Q2 loss and DTA cost guide; HCC is the clean captain"},
    {"what": "LCID/GM into auto OVERRIDE", "why": "Air recall and Canada-tariff risk; RUT captains do not confirm"},
    {"what": "LIND bounce / GBTG into BKNG", "why": "LIND w1 -17% disagrees; take-private is not travel demand"},
    {"what": "NWPX/WS as mill-steel beta", "why": "NWPX is water pipe; WS is Klöckner impairment"}
  ],
  "one_paragraph": "XLB’s -1% close mislabels two OVERRIDE longs: HCC Blue Creek (FY tons 13.0–14.0Mst, Q2 EBITDA $157M) versus AMR’s DTA miss, and NUE/STLD tariff-price beats (record mill shipments) that gold’s -5% w1 residual does not unwind. XLY’s +0.6% is a Tesla Cybercab Sep 3 print, not Detroit, Lucid, or apparel manufacturing, which stays 17% breadth with no live demand fact. Energy’s +2% is oil-major beta; OFS’s +5.6% w1 is SLB’s $3.4B Kelvion AI-cooling bid, while thermal-coal residual stays unconfirmed (CNR quiet, BTU Centurion-neg). XLP does not capture the BF-B FQ1 nested short into 09/02, and AIN’s CFO leave is the textile dump, not a bounce. WSM’s +6.2% comps raise is the specialty-retail nested long versus CASY/ASO calendar wait; RRR’s GVR reopen is the only casino nested bid under 0% breadth. Overnight futures and the calendar print are a pre-open job — this baseline does not size a morning gate."
}
```

## RESEARCH APPENDIX

**Queries run**
- Warrior Met Coal HCC Blue Creek 2026
- Nucor Steel Dynamics Q2 2026 results tariffs
- Tesla Cybercab robotaxi launch September 3 2026 Austin
- Williams-Sonoma Q2 2026 results raise guidance
- SLB Schlumberger Kelvion acquisition $3.4 billion data center
- Brown-Forman BF-B fiscal Q1 2027 earnings September 2 2026

**Key sources and facts used**

1. Motley Fool / HCC Q2 2026 transcript — https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/08/12/warrior-met-coal-hcc-q2-2026-earnings-call-transcript/ — 2026-08-12  
   Fact: Blue Creek longwall early; FY26 sales raised 13.0–14.0Mst; ~5Mst Blue Creek sales, ~90% contracted.

2. Reuters (card) / HCC ops — same Q2 print as flagged card (rev $509.7M, adj. EBITDA $156.9M, 3.7Mst).  
   Fact: HCC is the clean coking captain; not re-traded as XLB.

3. Nucor 8-K / PR Newswire — https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/nucor-reports-results-for-the-second-quarter-of-2026-302835608.html — Q2 2026  
   Fact: NI $1.16B ($5.04); sales $10.40B; record 7.1Mt mill shipments; Section 232 cited.

4. S&P Global — https://www.spglobal.com/energy/en/news-research/latest-news/metals/082726-americas-steelmakers-credit-tariffs-trade-defenses-for-stronger-markets — 2026-08-27  
   Fact: NUE/STLD credit 50% Section 232 and trade defenses for prices/volumes.

5. Steel Dynamics IR — https://ir.steeldynamics.com/steel-dynamics-reports-second-quarter-2026-results/ — 2026-07-21  
   Fact: Sales $6.1B, NI $534M ($3.69); record 3.7Mt steel shipments.

6. Yahoo Finance / Tesla Cybercab — https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/article/tesla-cybercab-to-launch-sept-3-as-robotaxi-bet-ramps-up-135557945.html — 2026-09-01  
   Fact: Invite-only Cybercab launch Sep 3 Austin; TSLA ~$367.95, +5.5% Aug 31.

7. Electrek — https://electrek.co/2026/08/24/tesla-cybercab-exclusive-access-robotaxi-sept-3/ — 2026-08-24  
   Fact: Exclusive-access Cybercab event Sep 3; not a mass public rollout.

8. Reuters Lucid (card) — https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/lucid-recall-more-than-27000-luxury-sedans-over-fire-risk-nhtsa-says-2026-08-28/ — 2026-08-28  
   Fact: 27,185 Air sedans recalled (26V540); veto LCID into auto OVERRIDE.

9. Business Wire / WSM Q2 — https://www.morningstar.com/news/business-wire/20260826865160/williams-sonoma-inc-announces-strong-second-quarter-2026-results — 2026-08-26  
   Fact: Comps +6.2%, non-GAAP EPS $2.10; FY rev +4.7–7.2%, OM 17.8–18.2%; $167.8M IEEPA refund in COGS.

10. Motley Fool WSM — https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/08/26/williams-sonoma-grew-comps-62-and-raised-full-year-guidance-heres-the-catch/ — 2026-08-26  
    Fact: Beat-and-raise despite housing; GAAP OM inflated by refunds.

11. Reuters SLB — https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/slb-acquire-kelvion-34-billion-2026-08-31/ — 2026-08-31  
    Fact: SLB to buy Kelvion for $3.4B cash; data-center cooling; close 1H 2027.

12. SLB IR — https://investorcenter.slb.com/news-releases/news-release-details/slb-acquire-kelvion-expanding-its-role-across-data-center/ — 2026-08-31  
    Fact: ~$700M debt assumed; ~$120M EBITDA synergies in three years.

13. Oilprice.com (card) — https://oilprice.com/Latest-Energy-News/World-News/SLB-Makes-34-Billion-Bet-on-AI-Data-Center-Boom.html — 2026-08-31  
    Fact: Same Kelvion terms; not a rig-count catch-up.

14. Business Wire BF-B — https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20260805026978/en/ — 2026-08-05  
    Fact: Fiscal Q1 2027 results due Sep 2 BMO (~8:00 a.m. EDT).

15. Ad-Hoc News BF-B (card) — https://www.ad-hoc-news.de/boerse/news/corporate-news/brown-forman-stock-trades-ahead-of-fiscal-q1-earnings-as-valuation/70016022 — 2026-08-28  
    Fact: Street ~$921.2M sales (-0.3% YoY), $0.38 EPS; prior miss; ~16.5x vs staples ~22.8x.

16. Yahoo Finance RRR (card) — https://finance.yahoo.com/real-estate/articles/could-rrrs-september-hotel-reopening-161700254.html — 2026-09-01  
    Fact: Green Valley Ranch East Tower full hotel reopening expected in September.

17. RTT News AIN (card) — https://www.rttnews.com/3687093/albany-international-appoints-sean-valashinas-acting-cfo-as-willard-station-takes-medical-leave.aspx — 2026-08-31  
    Fact: CFO Willard Station medical leave; Sean Valashinas acting PFO; shares -4.4%.

18. Peabody 8-K (card) — https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1064728/000106472826000038/btu8k20260729ex991.htm — 2026-07-29  
    Fact: Q2 net loss $90.6M; adj. EBITDA $24M; Centurion shortfalls — veto coal HEAT upgrade.

**Tape used (session-supplied, not searched)**  
SPY -0.30%, IWM -1.96%, XLB -1.01%, XLY +0.61%, XLE +2.04%, XLP -0.12%, XLK -1.12%, XLI -2.05%. Groups: Energy d1 +1.84 / breadth 0.806; Oil Services w1 +5.6 vs Energy +0.55; Gold w1 -5.11 vs XLB; Cyclical breadth 0.242.

**Not used as sentiment**  
Price-only moves; SIG UBS $121→$122 (too small to promote); NWPX water-pipe beat; WS Klöckner impairment; GBTG take-private; LIND Buy vs -17% w1; CNR succession.
